constraints.character: Use populated accepted first frame: coherent silver-black angelfish lead with fine scales, eye/gill detail, translucent fin rays and ventral filaments, plus smaller-fish community at varying depths. Preserve reference palette/anatomy/initial scale. No blue-orange identity drift, toy shading, clones, merged bodies or group disappearance. Static conditioning cannot guarantee temporal identity.
constraints.materials: Keep organic leaf/root texture, stable heavy wood, coherent rocks/substrate and depth-dependent water attenuation. Flexible tips and delicate fins stay continuous; no melting geometry, ghost duplicates or decorative pasted shimmer.
constraints.lighting: Restrained underwater daylight. Surface ripples and refracted highlights visibly change gently throughout; avoid exposure flash/flicker or seam pumping. Keep copy regions quiet and readable.
constraints.camera: Fixed submerged camera, uninterrupted framing, no pan/zoom/cuts. Requested 720p and nominal 24fps are targets; preserve and report returned native dimensions/rate rather than assume an exact match.
constraints.motion: All four layers active throughout: lead forward swim/propulsion and short curve/depth turn, independent short paths by smaller fish with speed/heading differences, ongoing surface/refraction movement, flexible tips/leaves swaying with one gentle left-to-right current. Root/leaf crossings use progressive physical occlusion. No hold, reverse/boomerang, opacity disappearance, doubled-fish crossfade or automatic finishing. Visible first frame only; no identical/empty last frame. Repeated-loop continuity remains an empirical gate.
constraints.environment: Accepted independent portrait: surface/arch above, fish in upper-middle water, dark lower reading habitat. Lead starts near x=53%,y=33%, fin envelope about 20% of source height; prominent fish/fins stay above y=47%. Top10% navigation and lower y=52-92% stay calm. Main fish remains visible under 390x844,390x667,320x800,320x568 crops. About thirteen smaller fish is a visual reference estimate, not a guaranteed census.

acceptance.criterion: Decode complete untouched raw output. Record native dimensions/FPS/frames/duration/audio and checksum, requested/actual differences and original bytes. Requested 720p is not assumed actual. Reject corrupt/truncated media.
Record provider-reported actual cost separately from bound estimate/ceiling and preserve unique request receipt. Unknown submission or unresolved charge discrepancy stops dependent calls, no retry.

Bind exact raw bytes. Separate technical, coordinator/independent visual inspection and explicit human film feedback. Static approval/ready preparation does not establish movie acceptance or paid authorization.

Full raw 1x playback and dense turn/occlusion samples retain accepted photographic lead/community, stable body/fins/palette, forward propulsion and depth turns. No plastic identity drift, malformed/merged fish, clone synchronization, fading or teleportation.

Community fish, surface ripples/refraction and flexible leaves/tips visibly move naturally from beginning through end. A moving lead over frozen water/plants fails. Same gentle current drives surface/leaf response; wood/rocks stay stable.

Compare accepted ecosystem-v3 reference with actual orientation-specific UI crops. Main fish retains prominence/full fins; trajectories clear copy/nav/action at reviewed desktop/mobile/narrow/short/landscape sizes. Peripheral school crop allowed; community disappearance is not.

Watch at least four complete raw forward plays and three consecutive joins at 1x. Reject jumps, exposure/refraction resets, plant-velocity changes and fish pop/doubling. First-frame-only input does not guarantee a loop. No freeze/reverse/hold/crossfade repair may hide failure. Any failed visual gate stops before portrait.
